QUOTE: The default target without a set call is `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` if you define it, and otherwise a stub that returns `NULL` (`platform.c:24-33`). The stub `free` does nothing. So forgetting the setter does not crash. Every allocation quietly fails and the library reports out-of-memory errors.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the uninitialised defaults are stubs: calloc returns NULL and free does nothing, so allocations fail instead of falling back to libc.
